items.title: Korean bank taps Ripple for payments, Pakistan opens crypto licensing: Asia Express
items.snippet: Asia’s biggest crypto hubs are locked in a tax-cut arms race, while Ripple will help Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank move money across borders.
items.note: Негативний тон для XRP за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Bitcoin hits $80,000 for the first time since May as crypto recovery accelerates
items.snippet: BTC has now surged 38% following its June plunge as shifting U.S. Treasury policy helped bring buyers back to crypto, rejuvenating ETF demand.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC за ключовими словами.
